note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; only the soldier is known, workers and alates are not recorded; the holotype is a soldier and the description is based on 3 soldiers; figure numbers and locality data are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Compared with M. dolichognathus, the mandibles are proportionally longer and the head slightly smaller, and the emargination of the anterior pronotal margin is shallower than in that species; M. fuscotibialis, its subspecies libericus and M. subtilis are all smaller; the subspecies validior is rather close, but the mandibular teeth are distinctly weaker in the figures of Silvestri (1914); in the subspecies libericus the third antennal segment is much smaller than the second; M. bequaertianus has straight sides of the head.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow; elongate oval; sides slightly rounded. Second antennal segment equal in length to the third, fourth segment slightly longer than the third. Labrum slightly pointed at the apex, sides slightly convergent posteriorly. Mandibles curved, strongly bent at the apex; black; inner margin strongly serrate. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly emarginate, angles rounded. Head length (with mandibles) 3.22 mm; head length (to antennal socket) 1.67 mm; head width 1.22 mm; pronotum length 0.39 mm, width 0.78 mm; left mandible length 1.20–1.30 mm.
